extracted.intended_audience: USPTO patent examiners, patent practitioners (attorneys and agents), and applicants
extracted.subtask_description: Table of contents for the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP), enumerating chapters and appendices that set forth substantive legal, procedural, and examination standards used in U.S. patent prosecution and examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: 100 Secrecy, Access, National Security, and Foreign Filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Secrecy, Access, National Security, and Foreign Filing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — full procedural and statutory guidance appears in the referenced MPEP chapter.

rubrics_metrics.name: 200 Types, Cross-Noting, and Status of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Types, Cross-Noting, and Status of Application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — see MPEP chapter for detailed rules on application types, cross-noting, and status handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: 300 Ownership and Assignment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — covers requirements and procedures for assignment and recordation.

rubrics_metrics.name: 400 Representative of Inventor or Owner
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — addresses who may represent inventors/owners and related procedures (powers of attorney, practitioner conduct).

rubrics_metrics.name: 500 Receipt and Handling of Mail and Papers
rubrics_metrics.description: Receipt and Handling of Mail and Papers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — details filing receipt rules, dates, correspondence handling, and related procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: 600 Parts, Form, and Content of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Parts, Form, and Content of Application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — includes requirements for specification, claims, drawings, oath/declaration, and formalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: 700 Examination of Applications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — contains standards and procedures for substantive examination of patentability, office actions, and examiner practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: 800 Restriction in Applications Filed Under 35 U.S.C. 111; Double Patenting
rubrics_metrics.description: Restriction in Applications Filed Under 35 U.S.C. 111; Double Patenting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — covers restriction practice, election of species, and double patenting rejections and responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: 900 Prior Art, Classification, and Search
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — addresses search and classification procedures and treatment of prior art.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1000 Matters Decided by Various U.S. Patent and Trademark Office Officials
rubrics_metrics.description: Matters Decided by Various U.S. Patent and Trademark Office Officials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — describes which matters are decided at various levels within the USPTO and related processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1100 Statutory Invention Registration (SIR) and Pre-Grant Publication (PG Pub)
rubrics_metrics.description: Statutory Invention Registration (SIR) and Pre-Grant Publication (PG Pub)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — covers procedures and consequences for SIR and pre-grant publication of applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1200 Appeal
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — contains procedures for appealing examiner decisions to the Patent Trial and Appeal Board and related practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1300 Allowance and Issue
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — addresses requirements and procedures for allowance, issue, payment of fees, and publication of patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1400 Correction of Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — includes procedures for certificate of correction, reissue, reexamination, and other corrective measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1500 Design Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — guidance specific to design patent examination, claims, drawings, and requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1600 Plant Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — covers the distinct requirements and examination practice for plant patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1700 Miscellaneous
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — miscellaneous topics not covered in other chapters.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1800 Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — procedures for international patent applications under the PCT and related USPTO practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1900 Protest
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — procedures for filing protests against pending patent applications and related handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2000 Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — requirements for disclosure of information (duty of candor) and related attorney/agent obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2100 Patentability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — substantive patentability standards (novelty, non-obviousness, utility, statutory subject matter) and examination guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2200 Citation of Prior Art and Ex Parte Reexamination of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Citation of Prior Art and Ex Parte Reexamination of Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — procedures for citation of prior art, reexamination requests, and reexamination practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2300 Interference Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — historical and procedural guidance for interferences (priority disputes) where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2400 Biotechnology
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — biotechnology-specific examination issues, written description, enablement, and related matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2500 Maintenance Fees
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — rules and procedures for payment of maintenance fees to keep patents in force.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2600 Optional Inter Partes Reexamination
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — procedures for inter partes reexamination and related practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2700 Patent Terms and Extensions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — calculation of patent term, term adjustments, and extensions (e.g., PTE).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix I Partial List of Trademarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix I Partial List of Trademarks
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — appendix content reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix II List of Decisions Cited
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix II List of Decisions Cited
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — appendix listing decisions cited in the MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix L Patent Laws
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — text or compilation of relevant patent statutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix R Patent Rules
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — USPTO rules and procedural regulations relevant to patent practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix T Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — PCT text or guidance included as an appendix.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix AI Administrative Instructions Under The PCT
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix AI Administrative Instructions Under The PCT
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — administrative instructions relating to PCT practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix P Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — Paris Convention material included as an appendix.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry — index to the MPEP.
